cube_warper.quest.003736C6E3EF0118.descr: A Refinery can be made to produce Sulfuric Acid from Sulfur Trioxide and Water.
cube_warper.quest.00F0B2F7923BBDAD.descr: Ender Dust can obtained by crushing End Stone.
cube_warper.quest.00F0B2F7923BBDAD.title: Ender Dust
cube_warper.quest.0123B7152870D571.title: Welcome to dimension 72: &lThe Gronglegrowth
cube_warper.quest.013DA58608406C7D.descr: The High-Tech Circuit Board is an important base component for the final machines.
cube_warper.quest.01A551720FDD9F68.descr: The Soldering Machine can create all kinds of electronics.
It will need to be supplied with Soldering Alloy which is made from molten Lead and molten Tin.
cube_warper.quest.025727EB1207A20C.descr: Gilded Blackstone can be mined for its gold.
cube_warper.quest.02C145CB0410E42F.descr: This ridiculously loud construction will be able to melt and alloy almost anything in existence.
Make sure you wear the right ear protection though.
cube_warper.quest.02EA6FCB8A583675.descr: Your natural surroundings can be distorted and corrupted using totem magic.
Build a totem with a Totem Base at the bottom and 5 runic logs on top.
Five Arcane Spirts will need to go on the totem to perform the ritual.
To start the Ritual, simply Right-click the totem base with the Totemic Staff. Soulwood Growth has a high chance to spawn but is not guaranteed. Bonemeal can be used to make it grow faster.
cube_warper.quest.02EA6FCB8A583675.title: Totem Magic
cube_warper.quest.032F81B9942E156B.descr: You can now store your power in the ME System.
This is convenient now, but it becomes crucial later on when your ME System goes interdimensional.
cube_warper.quest.032F81B9942E156B.title: Upload your Power
cube_warper.quest.0361D2B79875B653.descr: Right-clicking a Block of Mana Diamond with Warp Flux will transfrom it into a Block of Dragonstone.
cube_warper.quest.0361D2B79875B653.subti: &oIs this how the Elves do it?
cube_warper.quest.0361D2B79875B653.title: Transmuting into a Dragonstone
cube_warper.quest.03F601F6C4B86B5C.title: Welcome to dimension 2: &lThe Fenspire Deep
cube_warper.quest.043C4D3D34A0BD56.descr: Forsaken Idols are not cheap, but they can be fully automated.
Make sure you have its components properly automated before proper production.
cube_warper.quest.049D0B3AB51A2493.title: Droop Soup
cube_warper.quest.04D761E4AC9E2FAA.descr: If the Hexahedron breaks down in some unintended way, you can resolve a lot of problems by executing the following command:
This will reconstruct the technical bits inside the Hexahedron.
Your base will remain fully intact.
cube_warper.quest.04D761E4AC9E2FAA.title: In Case of Emergency
cube_warper.quest.06170C731F74C2A1.descr: In Carrion-485 the occasional Carrion Maw can be found in the ground.
Feeding it Chocolate Cake will make it spit out a Sweet Tooth.
cube_warper.quest.06170C731F74C2A1.subti: &oWe are the Music Makers, and we are the Dreamers of Dreams
cube_warper.quest.06170C731F74C2A1.title: Obtaining a Sweet Tooth
cube_warper.quest.0721C1EEAD957574.descr: You can create new Old Vectors by placing empty Vector Operators on the pedestal and pressing the button to rewind time.
cube_warper.quest.0721C1EEAD957574.title: Timewarping Vectors
cube_warper.quest.07D4A4DCB638CC93.descr: The Thermionic Fabricator can make Electron tubes using power and a supply of sand. It will need some time to heat up the sand into molten glass before it starts crafting.
cube_warper.quest.07F2D5A7CCA1A58B.descr: The Soul Cube can be found in The Lost Valley.
When a Soul Stone is Right-clicked on it, it will bring forth an undead army and consume the Soul Stone.
This might not seem super useful since these undead will attack you on sight, but they are wearing Necronium Armour.
The recipe for Necronium has been lost to time. Melting down their armour in an Arc Furnace might be the only way to get your hands on some Necronium Ingots.
cube_warper.quest.07F2D5A7CCA1A58B.title: The Soul Cube
cube_warper.quest.0921248B4773650A.descr: Runes can be made from Mystical Petals in combination with mana.
You will just need to find flowers in the right colours.
cube_warper.quest.0921248B4773650A.title: Runic Altar
cube_warper.quest.0A174D0B3636117B.descr: You can create spirits by crushing runes on a cutting board or by pulverizing them.
cube_warper.quest.0A174D0B3636117B.title: Smashing Runes
cube_warper.quest.0A96A6A3F883A86B.descr: Coke Bricks can be made from Limestone, Cinder Flour and Ash.
Ash can be obtained by shovelling it up after anything that can burn has fully burned down.
cube_warper.quest.0A96A6A3F883A86B.title: Coke Oven
cube_warper.quest.0AFC4BD8DFC8A929.descr: Both eyes are renewable in the Spirit Altar.
cube_warper.quest.0AFC4BD8DFC8A929.title: Renewable Eyeballs
cube_warper.quest.0C64583682770587.descr: The entire Timber Lakes consists of Asurine blow the surface.
If you can quarry and pulverize this mineral you can produce endless Zinc Ingots.
cube_warper.quest.0C64583682770587.title: Zinc Quarry
cube_warper.quest.0CBFA3982D725C91.descr: The Railgun can shoot almost any rod, which will deal a high amount of damage on impact.
You can charge the railgun in the Charging Station.
cube_warper.quest.0F12939AF08CC493.title: Welcome to dimension 8: &lTimber Lakes
cube_warper.quest.10992C2F23A96C79.title: Welcome to dimension 1: &lStranded-233
cube_warper.quest.10B4D789801FA7A3.descr: Uranium Rods will be needed to fuel the Nuclear Furnace.
cube_warper.quest.114FBF1B629A980D.descr: You can create Flawed Budding Certus blocks using the Crystallizer.
The Growth Accelerator will need to be hooked up to the ME-System and will speed up the growth of the crystals significantly.
cube_warper.quest.114FBF1B629A980D.title: Budding Certus
cube_warper.quest.11650877F274EF55.descr: The Akashic Tome contains all the guidebooks you will ever need.
If you are ever unsure on how to do something, make sure to check the guidebook of the corresponding mod.
Once you have morphed The Tome into one of the guidebooks you can Left-click it to transform it back into the Akashic Tome.
cube_warper.quest.11650877F274EF55.title: The Akashic Tome
cube_warper.quest.1303271D201C87A7.descr: &lThe Interdimensional Transceiver is a crucial block when it comes to setting up interdimensional automation.&r
Start by placing the first Transceiver inside your main base; make sure it's hooked up to a powered ME System and click on "Mode" to make it a sender.
Next, make a new channel by clicking "Add" and give it any name. Click on it in the list to select it.
Now that the sender is set up, you can place an infinite number of Transceivers anywhere and hook them all up to the same sending Transceiver by clicking the channel you made in the list.
cube_warper.quest.1303271D201C87A7.title: Interdimensional Transceiver
cube_warper.quest.130D8C347C0B0AB6.descr: The strange structures in the Extraterrestrial Hills can be shot with a Large Arrow using either a bow or a dispenser.
Hitting the structure will reveal its hidden Extraterrestrial Crystals.
You have to mine these crystals quickly since they will disappear again after only a few seconds.
Of course, if you would automate the breaking, you could get a lot more crystals per arrow.
cube_warper.quest.130D8C347C0B0AB6.title: Generating Extraterrestrial Crystals
cube_warper.quest.135F7CA45A2CE98C.descr: Tin can be obtained from crushing Extraterrestrial Stone.
Extraterrestrial Stone does not spawn naturally and only generates from stone generators in the Extraterrestrial Hills.
cube_warper.quest.135F7CA45A2CE98C.title: Renewable Tin
cube_warper.quest.13A90A5B0A9984F6.descr: The Flamethrower is a powerful weapon that deals direct AOE burning damage to your targets.
cube_warper.quest.141D5FA7C09C176A.descr: Using the Mechanical Press you can now recreate Hydraullic Press videos by crushing things very slowly.
cube_warper.quest.1421E91BC9378574.descr: You can obtain infinite gold by melting gold coins. Any stone generator in The Coin Continiuum will generate gold coins instead.
cube_warper.quest.1421E91BC9378574.title: Renewable Gold
cube_warper.quest.16D1607818EA293D.descr: With the Metallurgic Infuser you will be able to make Control Circuits.
cube_warper.quest.179AB6E02372A596.title: Welcome to dimension 36: &lThe Lost Valley
cube_warper.quest.17D1A9962C519245.descr: With Blaze Burners it is possible to extract the iron from the endless blood ocean located in dimension 16.
Where this blood came from does not seem to concern you...
cube_warper.quest.17D1A9962C519245.title: Renewable Iron
cube_warper.quest.181F1947B08FFF44.descr: Alpha Particles can be made in the Combiner from the Alpha flowers found in this dimension.
Note that both the Alpha Rose and the Alpha Dandelion can be produced in the Phytogenic Insolator.
cube_warper.quest.181F1947B08FFF44.title: Alpha Particles
cube_warper.quest.186BE3D50FBAC8D8.descr: Using the FTB map you can force load chunks so that setups work even when you are not currently present in that specific area.
Simply click the second map icon in the top left of your inventory screen. There you will be able to claim chunks.
You can shift right-click on loaded chunks on the map to force load them.
cube_warper.quest.186BE3D50FBAC8D8.title: Loading Chunks
cube_warper.quest.19691D3E91B00F71.descr: Pressing any log will yield Rubber. You can create Cured Rubber by smelting it
cube_warper.quest.19691D3E91B00F71.title: Making Rubber
cube_warper.quest.1AA2701817C05F20.descr: Any flower can be turned into Mystical Petals of its color. The rare Snowdrop in The Frostbloom Storm gives the white petals needed for a Pure Daisy.
The Pure Daisy can turn Deepslate into Brilliant Deepslate.
cube_warper.quest.1AA2701817C05F20.title: Pure Daisy
cube_warper.quest.1ACBFD0A2732FA5C.descr: Blocks of Emerald can be found in the Coin Continuum and broken down into Emeralds.
cube_warper.quest.1AD73B0A7B843C82.descr: Shiverstone can be crushed or pulverized for Osmium Nuggets.
Stone generators located in the frostbloom storm will generate Shiverstone instead of regular Cobblestone.
cube_warper.quest.1AD73B0A7B843C82.title: Osmium Mining
cube_warper.quest.1B9BD40F42E3D0A5.descr: With the Chemical Oxidizer you can make Sulfur Trioxide.
Sulfur Trioxide will be produced as a gas but can be turned into a liquid with the Rotary Condensentrator.
cube_warper.quest.1B9BD40F42E3D0A5.title: Infusing with Oxygen
cube_warper.quest.1C48F58D90ECDFA4.descr: There are Certus Quartz Crystals growing on the Ceiling of Ferrum-6.
cube_warper.quest.1D39E9C67C28C53A.descr: Using the shrine in Timber Lakes you can rewind the time of certain blocks.
&lo&r Block of Iron -> Block of Shiny Ingot
&lo&r Block of Emerald -> The Time Stone
cube_warper.quest.1D39E9C67C28C53A.title: Rewinding Time
cube_warper.quest.1D855C82AF9E2087.title: Welcome to dimension 12: &lThe Frostbloom Storm
cube_warper.quest.1DF9F6C26950EFBC.descr: Osmium can found in the ground of this dimension between the Shiverstone.
cube_warper.quest.1E41EDAFE5271147.descr: The Gourmaryllis can eat anything eatable to generate mana.
The Kekimurus will convert any cakes placed next to it into mana.
Both these flowers can be found in dimension 24.
cube_warper.quest.1E41EDAFE5271147.title: Feed Your Flowers
cube_warper.quest.1F2CA8F24F6AFB93.title: Welcome to dimension 10: &lThe Brimwood Plains
cube_warper.quest.1F81CCC1F7562C57.descr: The ME Controller will dramatically improve the number of channels you can have in your ME System.
cube_warper.quest.1F81CCC1F7562C57.subti: &oI got this from a Chance Cube
cube_warper.quest.20827613C878D74D.descr: Frozen Flesh can be smelted into Leather. With the Cattails in dimension 2 you will be able to make string.
This will allow you to make Backpacks.
cube_warper.quest.20827613C878D74D.title: Pack your Bags
cube_warper.quest.21858D3EA2248A30.title: Welcome to dimension 4: &lThe Redvein Expanse
cube_warper.quest.219FE0DD9D5470C8.title: Wireless Terminal
cube_warper.quest.22452FEA02C38183.descr: The Magma Crucible will be able to smelt any Glowstone into Energized Glowstone.
cube_warper.quest.22556B2096D509A1.descr: Livingrock boulders can be found naturally in this dimension.
Stone generators in this dimension will also generate Livingrock.
cube_warper.quest.225FF21D6FE56470.descr: The Multiservo Press can reshape your metals using pretty much any mold.
cube_warper.quest.2315D62DBA22EFC8.descr: When The Missing Core is placed down and Right-clicked with Alpha Particles it will currupt the local environment into Missing blocks that can be harvested for Missing Items.
Missing Items can be sacrificed to the Weeping Well for Nullpoint items.
cube_warper.quest.2315D62DBA22EFC8.title: Duplicate that what is Missing
cube_warper.quest.23B11C5E9631918A.title: Welcome to dimension 96: &lLavender Fields
cube_warper.quest.243AFF85A4B9DEAC.title: Welcome to dimension 14: &lExtraterrestrial Hills
cube_warper.quest.28EC0CE38E4640DE.descr: Power Casing can be used to make most of the Actually Additions machines.
cube_warper.quest.28FB9EDAB196A3BC.descr: Using the Empowerer Infused Alloy can now be created.
cube_warper.quest.29192445C9E655E1.title: Inscribing
cube_warper.quest.294927CF94DF28A9.title: Welcome to dimension 9: &lThe Horizon of Cinders
cube_warper.quest.2C8A8C043BF486A1.descr: Gummy Rings can be duplicated by spouting them with a small amount of Lumisene.
This should allow you to create infinite Lumisene with the right setup.
cube_warper.quest.2C8A8C043BF486A1.title: The Infinite Gummy Cycle
cube_warper.quest.2D69B59AE399754E.descr: Molten Steel can be made in a Basin using a Basin Lid. After that it can be poured into the right mold.
cube_warper.quest.2D69B59AE399754E.title: Building a Foundry
cube_warper.quest.2E44834F6BA2F4C0.descr: The Alloy Smelter will allow you to make Reinforced Alloy and Solarium.
cube_warper.quest.2EDCB3D5FE954B4A.descr: Using the Ritual Circle, you can bind a Crimson Eye inside a Vector Operator. Where this will bring you is unknown.
There is only one way to find out...
cube_warper.quest.304389322101F300.descr: Using the Soldering Machine, you can start making basic components.
Because this machine needs a pre-configured recipe, it might be a good idea to make more than one.
cube_warper.quest.30A0ACC1C6D738A8.descr: Board the Hexahedron and press the big red button!
cube_warper.quest.30A0ACC1C6D738A8.title: Getting Started
cube_warper.quest.31BF68FFC2949A89.descr: Because of the nature of this modpack, it is best to not push your render distance beyond 12 chunks.
This goes mainly for when the Hexahedron is changing its location to a fully new dimension.
cube_warper.quest.31BF68FFC2949A89.title: Load Chunks with care
cube_warper.quest.331319E9F6BD173A.descr: Cut Copper can be smelted into Copper Ingots.
You will need to scrape the oxidation off first before smelting it.
cube_warper.quest.33166A16A7F37C34.descr: Some items thrown into Weeping Wells located in the Lavender Fields can get transformed. The conversion takes a few seconds.
It is recommended you automate this process.
cube_warper.quest.33166A16A7F37C34.title: The Weeping Well
cube_warper.quest.3362A3145B9D5745.descr: Using the shrine in the Storm Islands, you can harness the power of the local weather to empower certain items.
A small lightning rod structure should be constructed on top as depicted in the image below.
&lThe button at the base of the structure will only start the conversion if the accumulator in the lightning rod is fully charged.&r
The item that you want to transform should be placed on the pedestal located at the lower part of the structure.
cube_warper.quest.3362A3145B9D5745.title: Lightning in a Bottle
cube_warper.quest.3566CE49C98A4730.descr: You can find the occasional Runewood Tree in this dimension. Make sure you keep some alive to harvest their sap.
cube_warper.quest.365A0560F237D1FC.descr: The Darkslate in this dimension can be crushed into Raw Nickel.
In addition to that, stone generators in the Umbral Sea will generate Darkslate.
cube_warper.quest.365A0560F237D1FC.title: Renewable Nickel
cube_warper.quest.37942CC359146473.descr: The Pulverizer can turn various materials into their dust form.
cube_warper.quest.3811EE766D2CF5C5.descr: Right-clicking empty bottles on Toxic Geothermal vents will fill them with Radon Gas.
cube_warper.quest.3811EE766D2CF5C5.subti: &o&oThis Place is Still Better than Bilewater
cube_warper.quest.3811EE766D2CF5C5.title: Collecting Radon
cube_warper.quest.38561DF4074FA9DC.descr: A stone generator in this dimension will generate Brimstone.
Crushing it will yeild Netherrack, Sulfur and a tiny amount of Cobalt.
cube_warper.quest.38561DF4074FA9DC.title: Brimstone Generator
cube_warper.quest.390F0E7876ACC11A.descr: Ancient Scrap can be found all over the Forsaken Planes. Combined with Gold you can now make Netherite.
cube_warper.quest.39199FC922CE2D82.descr: The outer shell of the Eye Pillars can be broken with two Eye Breakers to reveal the Crimson Eye within.
Simply place one on either side of the eye and Right-click one of the breakers.
cube_warper.quest.39199FC922CE2D82.title: Breaking Out the Crimson Eyes
cube_warper.quest.394A9F2BBF941C4E.title: Welcome to dimension 64: &lCarrion-485
cube_warper.quest.394C0194156AAE7C.descr: The Groglets native to the Gronglegrowth can be quite useful.
Feeding them different items makes them produce the following valuable resources:
cube_warper.quest.39CD55C645EF2F8E.descr: Supercomputers are one of the final items.
Make sure you have its components properly automated before proper production.
cube_warper.quest.39CD55C645EF2F8E.title: Supercomputer
cube_warper.quest.3AEDF7B7730CA73D.descr: The SAG Mill will be your first EnderIO machine.
EnderIO machines will need a capacitor inside in order to function properly.
cube_warper.quest.3AF072EAB2673491.descr: An Eyeball Yolk can be obtained by breaking a Carrion Eye.
The peeking Circuit is used in a lot of late game machines and further components. Make sure to automate it and its parts.
cube_warper.quest.3AF072EAB2673491.subti: &oStart to worry when your Electronics start to look back
cube_warper.quest.3AF072EAB2673491.title: Peeking Circuits
cube_warper.quest.3B641BF9DC84200A.descr: Dark Steel is needed for multiple recipes on the tech side of this chapter.
cube_warper.quest.3B641BF9DC84200A.title: Dark Steel
cube_warper.quest.3BFBC00147BE58DF.descr: Phenolic Resin can be made using ethanol and a superheated mixer.
Blaze Cakes should be a lot easier to make since you can go to a dimension that is almost entirely made up of layers of cake.
cube_warper.quest.3BFBC00147BE58DF.title: Advanced Electronic Component
cube_warper.quest.3C0C5BE247CF991A.descr: The High Pressure Refinery Unit can be used to create Plastic and Circuit Boards depending on if you feed it Heavy or Light Oil.
It might be a good idea to make a dedicated machine for both recipes.
cube_warper.quest.3C0C5BE247CF991A.subti: &oWhat am I Supposed to do \nwith Heavy Oil Residue?
cube_warper.quest.3CDFB7634E1757EC.descr: Crushing Wheels are not only able to Crush Blaze burners into Blaze Dust. But they are also extremely efficient at crushing down rocks quickly.
A set of Crushing Wheels at full speed can go through stacks of stone in a matter of seconds.
This should allow you to crush the different stone types from the different dimensions extremely quickly.
cube_warper.quest.3CDFB7634E1757EC.title: Crushing Wheels
cube_warper.quest.3EFB28B57ACCA844.descr: Using the Thermionic Fabricator you can now create new Empty Vector Operators.
cube_warper.quest.3F4EC0FB4D799F62.descr: The Occult Gem can be made with a Spirit Infusion Altar.
cube_warper.quest.3F6624FB96478C8D.title: Blaze Vector Operator
cube_warper.quest.40111918A62390D4.descr: You can Shift-right-click a Uranium Rod in you inventory to fully recharge an empty Raygun.
cube_warper.quest.40236AE18FD2B000.descr: All four Gummy Rings can be found in dimension 24. In a Cooking Pot they can be turned into the highly flamable Lumisene.
cube_warper.quest.40236AE18FD2B000.title: Collecting all the Rings
cube_warper.quest.405827CC19935F88.descr: The Default Cube can be made from Alpha Clay.
cube_warper.quest.405827CC19935F88.title: Default Cube
cube_warper.quest.41914B292526CC00.title: Welcome to dimension 24: &lThe Sugarscape
cube_warper.quest.41DD32EB5E41B666.descr: Since Dreamwood grows naturally in the Lavender Fields, no portal is needed to trade for it.
cube_warper.quest.4371A7827F334251.descr: Crushing Darkslate has a slight chance to produce a Soul Stone.
cube_warper.quest.43823F2E6C3DD6A1.descr: In this strange new dimension you can find Old Vector Operators.
Placing them onto the three plugs inside the Hexahedron will allow you to travel to new dimensions.
Each of the Old Vector Operators
adds +1. So for example, two in a row will send you to dimension 2.
cube_warper.quest.454DD9A7F78B055C.descr: &lThe stone generated from stone generators is diffrent in every dimension.&r
In the Horizon of Cinders seared cobblestone will be generated.
cube_warper.quest.454DD9A7F78B055C.title: Seared Cobblestone Generator
cube_warper.quest.4555E52C2484D80A.descr: Glowstone can be created in the Spirit Crucible and melted in the Magma Crucible for liquid Energised Glowstone.
Energised Glowstone is a major component in the creation of Blaze Fuel.
cube_warper.quest.4555E52C2484D80A.title: Energized Glowstone
cube_warper.quest.48D52434D4D010CD.descr: Any stone generator located in The Redvein Expanse will generate Raw Redstone instead of Cobblestone.
This can soon be pulverized into renewable redstone.
cube_warper.quest.48D52434D4D010CD.title: Redstone Generator
cube_warper.quest.4944F4A26FE8C3EB.descr: You can make a Dynamo that runs on Uranium Fuel Rods.
One Uranium Rod will burn for
30 minutes and will output a steady
500 RF/t as long as the Dynamo can output its power.
cube_warper.quest.4944F4A26FE8C3EB.title: Nuclear Power
cube_warper.quest.4949402D803E7D7C.descr: By placing Bulk Fermenters in a column and heating them from below, you can make Blaze Fuel.
Items must be pushed into the structure by hoppers.
cube_warper.quest.4949402D803E7D7C.title: Bulk Fermenter
cube_warper.quest.497247820F413C0E.descr: The Spirit Altar can be used to create many items of magical nature.
When crafting, it uses item components from the pedestals.
Spirits are also needed for the crafting process. The Spirits can be put directly on the Spirit Altar itself.
The Altar can hold more Spirits than it needs. The leftover spirits will stay on the Altar for your next craft.
cube_warper.quest.498E60F53CA8DC47.descr: You can soon pulverize Skystone into Skystone Dust.
It might be a good idea to stock up on this to prevent having to come back to this dimension constantly.
cube_warper.quest.4B1F78DCF2E2C538.descr: You can generate infinite Uranium by crushing Radrock.
Any stone generator located in the Fission Fields will generate Radrock instead of Cobblestone.
cube_warper.quest.4BDF72AE9BF4F899.descr: Droopfruit in its raw state isn't the greatest food source. But it can keep you alive.
Consider making Droop Soup in order to improve its nutritional value.
New berries can only appear when the plant grows downwards.
cube_warper.quest.4D120E3BFAD52367.descr: Constructing Modular Reactors will not be easy. Make sure you have its components properly automated before proper production.
cube_warper.quest.4D120E3BFAD52367.title: Modular Reactor
cube_warper.quest.4EDB043848C115B1.descr: When Runic Sap is Fed to a Gronglet it will poop out Gunpowder.
cube_warper.quest.4EDB043848C115B1.title: Renewable Gunpowder
cube_warper.quest.4EF6E1518A06155D.descr: Mysterious cubes can be found in The Redvein Expanse.
upon breaking them they will drop all five diffrent presses.
cube_warper.quest.4EF6E1518A06155D.title: Alien Tech
cube_warper.quest.4F05D057277AA7FE.descr: Runic trees can be tapped for runic sap by right-clicking with a bottle on the stripped log where the sap is coming out of the tree.
cube_warper.quest.4F05D057277AA7FE.title: Runic Sap
cube_warper.quest.500C36B667B15D5C.descr: The Lightning Rod multiblock has been slightly improved.
It now also generates power when artificial lightnig like from a lightning charge hits the top of one of the steel fences.
&lThe Lightning Shrine can convert Copper Dust into a Lightning Charge.&r
Using this method you will need power to make power. But each lightning strike should yeild a net positive of ~200.000 RF depending on how fast you can drain the Lighting Rod.
cube_warper.quest.500C36B667B15D5C.title: Harnessing the Power of the Gods
cube_warper.quest.5013895EE10C5D81.descr: A Deployer can also kickstart the ritual automatically if it clicks on a Block of Living Flesh while it is holding the Desolate Dagger.
The Block of Living Flesh will not be consumed during this process.
cube_warper.quest.5013895EE10C5D81.subti: &oFrom the Moment I Understood the Weakness of my Flesh, it Disgusted me...
cube_warper.quest.5013895EE10C5D81.title: Mechanical Sacrifice
cube_warper.quest.50553C4CCED700E3.descr: Right-clicking a Recall Tube will teleport the user to the inside of the Hexahedron, even when the Hexahedron is in a different dimension.
cube_warper.quest.5062CBABFE108855.descr: The Crystallizer can form various crystals as long as it has a good supply of water.
cube_warper.quest.50FD9623DE826974.title: Welcome to dimension 16: &lBlood Ocean
cube_warper.quest.518F46AD732A3102.descr: You can Centrifuge Inverted Sand to Obtain Fluorite Dust.
cube_warper.quest.52154BA08802DE96.subti: &oI'm sorry Dave, I'm Afraid I can't do that
cube_warper.quest.52BADFDDBC19F479.descr: You can turn an Iron plate into almost any press using the Stonecutter.
cube_warper.quest.52BADFDDBC19F479.title: Getting the Presses
cube_warper.quest.53536FA9268ECC39.descr: Using Warp Flux you can now transmute blocks of metals that have been placed by Right-Clicking Warp Flux on them.
cube_warper.quest.53536FA9268ECC39.title: Lead into Gold
cube_warper.quest.5369027A022EB46D.descr: Pepermint powder and Frostmint will be needed to construct the Blast Chiller and catalyse reactions within the machine.
cube_warper.quest.5369027A022EB46D.title: Take a Mint
cube_warper.quest.547C18CF2C6FA3D6.descr: By recycling the Necronium armor left behind by the undead you can make a Void Chassis.
cube_warper.quest.547C18CF2C6FA3D6.title: Void Chassis
cube_warper.quest.54CBDFF7F7215FC5.title: Universal Cable
cube_warper.quest.562B1530139F8AEA.descr: The heavy Engineering Block will allow you to make multiblocks that are a lot more complex.
If you are ever unsure on how to build a multiblock make sure to use the handy Projector.
cube_warper.quest.567345FAFE9D5DAE.title: Dimensional Tourist
cube_warper.quest.56A2089DBDAAEA29.descr: The Enrichment Chamber allows you to refine Uranium Shards into Yellow Cake Uranium.
cube_warper.quest.57121F1DD7739B2D.title: Welcome to dimension &k999&r: &lThe Edge of Reality
cube_warper.quest.57F2E56BF5B24561.descr: With the Molecular Assembler you can automate any crafting recipe.
cube_warper.quest.585121A406995B35.title: Welcome to dimension 32: &lThe Azurewood
cube_warper.quest.59B914C684A5EE4C.descr: The Nuclear Furnace can be contructed with eight nuclear Furnace Components.
If it is fueled with Uranium Rods it can turn:
&lo&r Empty Vector Operators into Nuclear Vector Operators
In this process the nuclear furnace will accumulate nuclear waste.
You can remove this by providing it with Metal Barrels.
&lIf you let the internal waste resevour fill up to the maximum limit the furnace will destroy itself and everything around it in a nuclear meltdown.&r
cube_warper.quest.59B914C684A5EE4C.title: Constructing a Nuclear Furnace
cube_warper.quest.5A06D773028BC9D2.descr: Pure Darkness is an important crafing ingredient.
Read the Conducting Rituals book on how to preform this ritual.
cube_warper.quest.5A06D773028BC9D2.title: Ritual of Darkness
cube_warper.quest.5A3062A00E9E98F9.descr: The Smelter can create the Seared Alloy that is needed for Create. Later on this task can be taken over by the Mechanical Mixer.
cube_warper.quest.5A3080407E21CCC2.descr: You can turn Redstone into Energized Redstone using the first shrine located in the Redvein Expanse.
Right-clicking Redstone onto the Ancient Redstone Core will convert it into Energized Redstone.
This will have a slight cooldown. Do note however that any automated systems like deployers do not suffer from this cooldown.
It might be a good idea to setup a local passive steam engine to avoid having to come back to this dimension constantly.
cube_warper.quest.5B67DE1C52A6C4AD.descr: In a abandonned Hexahedron there sits a Broken Vector Operator...
cube_warper.quest.5B67DE1C52A6C4AD.title: The Infinity Vector
cube_warper.quest.5EF27D3655B2D23D.descr: Blaze Burners can be crushed using Crushing Wheels to yield Blaze Powder and Blaze Rods.
cube_warper.quest.5EF27D3655B2D23D.title: Sacrificing Blazes
cube_warper.quest.5F390AE1F113B848.descr: Right-clicking stripped Soulwood with any axe it will reveal the Cursed Sap within the tree.
When Cursed Sap is Fed to a Gronglet it will poop out Grains of Infinity.
cube_warper.quest.5F390AE1F113B848.title: Grains of Inifinity
cube_warper.quest.5F442664FA982CEF.descr: Using the Centrifuge you can turn Metal Swarf into lead.
cube_warper.quest.5F442664FA982CEF.title: Renewable Lead
cube_warper.quest.5F45EF4EDED9B5EA.descr: Peat is a powerful natural fuel source that allows you to conserve wood since you can now burn this stuff instead.
cube_warper.quest.5F9D8874286DFFA0.descr: Chocolate Chips can be made by chilling molten chocolate with the right press.
Chocolate does not have to be created from scratch. Existing chocolate items can be melted down in a heated basin.
cube_warper.quest.5FADC584E46C9392.descr: Using the Spirit Crucible you can generate a whole assortment of resources using different &oimpetuses&r.
cube_warper.quest.5FB02F53EA532C75.descr: Nether Quartz can be obtained by washing Soul Sand.
Scoria can be generated using water and lava in this dimension and can be crushed into infinite Soul Sand.
cube_warper.quest.61CB35448C2C96A5.descr: The chalk in this dimension can be crushed into Bauxite.
In addition to that, stone generators on the Storm Islands will generate Chalk.
cube_warper.quest.61CB35448C2C96A5.title: Renewable Aluminium
cube_warper.quest.61EBAB9F6E904FE8.descr: Fireproof Steel Coating can be made with the Netherrack Shavings produced from Netherrack with the SAG Mill.
cube_warper.quest.6291AD460BD9EA70.title: Welcome to dimension 48: &lThe Umbral Sea
cube_warper.quest.62FCB4D691D5A46A.descr: The Hazmat Suit will not only protect you from radiation but will also allow the wearer to smim in acid.
cube_warper.quest.62FCB4D691D5A46A.title: Hazmat Suit
cube_warper.quest.6483A804AEE2CFED.descr: The Broken Vector Operator can be repaired, but this process needs to be executed fast and properly planned beforehand.
There are twelve total recipe steps that need to happen in order.
The twelfth and final step is to place the Broken Vector Operator back on the Vector Tuner &lwithin 10 minutes&r.
At any point you can place the unfinished Vector back on the Vector Tuner to reset the time and start over at step one.
This will not be easy, but you made it this far. Plan ahead and you will be more than capable of doing this.
You got this, best of luck!
cube_warper.quest.6483A804AEE2CFED.title: The Final Process
cube_warper.quest.657795D12BDBF335.title: Welcome to dimension 128: &lAlpha-201
cube_warper.quest.65865592B7FBB1CC.title: Welcome to dimension 13: &lStorm Islands
cube_warper.quest.660475C0C9A71E8E.descr: Using your generated power you can now charge up Empty Vector Operators to create Charged Vector Operators.
cube_warper.quest.66858347C4FDB6F3.descr: The somewhat rare Diamond lamps can be crushed into Diamonds.
cube_warper.quest.66858347C4FDB6F3.title: Hoarding Diamonds
cube_warper.quest.66D36B4E2249E0C2.descr: Using the Nuclear Furnace Fissile Cores are now renewable.
cube_warper.quest.66D36B4E2249E0C2.title: Creating more Cores
cube_warper.quest.66E6BFE29C256D20.descr: If you would somehow lose the Broken Vector in any way, you can use the following command while standing next to the Vector Tuner to reset the Broken Vector:
cube_warper.quest.66E6BFE29C256D20.title: Lost Vector Reset
cube_warper.quest.66E80DDD90727B7A.descr: Defeating the Non-Players will make them drop The Missing Core.
Read the Conducting Rituals book on how to preform this ritual.
cube_warper.quest.66E80DDD90727B7A.title: Ritual of the Missing
cube_warper.quest.6792284C323C3684.title: Welcome to dimension 17: &lThe Forsaken Plains
cube_warper.quest.67DA5464418D95A8.descr: The Magmatic Dynamo can generate energy using lava.
For now you will have to bucket the lava in yourself. But you will be able to automatically pump endless magma lakes from this dimension into the hexahedron in the next chapter.
cube_warper.quest.6840D094E91491E5.title: Petal Apothecary
cube_warper.quest.6895C817C27DBF50.title: Welcome to dimension 6: &lFerrum-6
cube_warper.quest.690B3942936F5A31.descr: When a Void Soul Knight in the Forsaken Planes is hit with a Burrowing Arrow, a piece of its armor will be chipped off.
The Forsaken Slag can be picked up and used to make Forsaken Bronze or Soularium.
cube_warper.quest.690B3942936F5A31.title: Obtaining Forsaken Bronze
cube_warper.quest.695F411874E4905F.title: Welcome to dimension 7: &lThe Coin Continuum
cube_warper.quest.69E8E5DC69DEBAB1.descr: Blood combined with any Quartz Dust in the Crystallizer
cube_warper.quest.69FF98931C1012F1.descr: With a crafting unit multiblock, you can automate any recipe.
Use the AE2 guide, or hold [G] while hovering over an item for more information.
cube_warper.quest.69FF98931C1012F1.title: Auto Crafting
cube_warper.quest.6A45F3EB58F78D23.descr: To make Techno Optics you will need to make the Slice'N'Splice
cube_warper.quest.6A4BA7BAD1500457.descr: The Smeltery can melt cannonballs obtained from dimension 1 into molten lead.
You can cast molten lead into either Lead Ingots or Blocks of Lead.
cube_warper.quest.6B061413A7EEBC3B.title: Utility Machines
cube_warper.quest.6BD9302EF68EEE51.descr: You can speed up machines using the stored time inside The Timestone.
cube_warper.quest.6BD9302EF68EEE51.title: Obtaining a Timestone
cube_warper.quest.6C140B16BB0A73A8.descr: Digging up the huge columns of cobblestone can provide you with the stone to make some basic tools and a furnace.
Remember that there is Veinminer in this pack, which allows you to collect a lot of cobble quickly.
cube_warper.quest.6C140B16BB0A73A8.title: Collecting Rocks
cube_warper.quest.6C52C4A4BFFE9BF0.descr: The true nature of the Edge of Reality is undocumented.
You will only know what there is to do here once you visit this destination...
cube_warper.quest.6C52C4A4BFFE9BF0.title: The Edge of Reality
cube_warper.quest.6C931B0EC40E1417.descr: With Copper and a bit of Iron you can make a passive Steam Engine.
You can use Fluiducts and a servo to supply the boiler with water.
This will create a basic constant source of rotation.
cube_warper.quest.6F744E3EB34D5ED7.title: Welcome to dimension 3: &lCopper Graveyard
cube_warper.quest.6FB4B571A199E199.descr: A lot of tasks can be automated with deployers. It might be a good idea to set these up in the right locations quite early.
cube_warper.quest.6FB4B571A199E199.title: Busy Hands
cube_warper.quest.70563D25C851EDE2.descr: Galena can be pulverised into Silicon using the pulverizer.
Do note that stone generators in Ferrum-6 generate Galena.
cube_warper.quest.70563D25C851EDE2.title: Silicon
cube_warper.quest.706CFA622308E0A2.descr: The Silver Forest has endless silver oceans.
If you right-click a filled bucket on a smeltery drain, it will fill the smeltery up with that liquid.
Alternatively, you can pump any liquid into a smeltery drain as well.
cube_warper.quest.706CFA622308E0A2.title: Endless Silver
cube_warper.quest.71A24C101C595EEF.descr: This 16 block high multiblock can fraction Crude Oil for further processing.
Remember that you can use a Projector to make sure you build it properly.
cube_warper.quest.71A95CEBD6B55B80.descr: The Osmium Compressor allows you to infuse materials with Osmium.
cube_warper.quest.722B22AF736527D1.descr: While holding the default &otilde&r key (~) you can mine a lot of adjacent blocks at once as long as they are of the same type.
This is quite a handy tool that prevents tasks from becoming to grindy.
You can rebind this key in the controls menu under "FTB Ultimine".
cube_warper.quest.722B22AF736527D1.title: Excavate all the Things
cube_warper.quest.724BF4D8D1DA930D.title: Welcome to dimension 5: &lThe Fission Fields
cube_warper.quest.72A11E4DE0439CFD.descr: The Peat Fired Engine will allow you to generate your first bit of power.
Simply provide it with peat and a redstone signal.
Do note that this generator can only burn peat and nothing else.
cube_warper.quest.7364187F70EFBB1D.descr: These three machines will be needed to make the Modular Reactor.
cube_warper.quest.7364187F70EFBB1D.title: Nuclear Industries
cube_warper.quest.736B7720A9B289FC.descr: You can fill a Bottle with Ender Air by Right-clicking it anywhere in the Lavender Fields
cube_warper.quest.736B7720A9B289FC.title: Ender Air Bottle
cube_warper.quest.7391519637010467.descr: In order to start conducting rituals, you will need to create a Desolate Dagger.
After that Read the book on how to use the ritual circle carefully.
cube_warper.quest.7391519637010467.subti: &oWe are Friends. Welcome. Sit and Rest.
cube_warper.quest.7391519637010467.title: The Ritual Circle
cube_warper.quest.743EC92ABFF82A3E.descr: The shrine in the brimwood planes will erupt and spew out a Blaze if a ignited TNT is dropped into the central hole.
cube_warper.quest.743EC92ABFF82A3E.title: Catching a Blaze
cube_warper.quest.7508558D7BE9594A.descr: You can recapture the eyes for your own machines.
Read the Conducting Rituals book on how to preform this ritual.
cube_warper.quest.7508558D7BE9594A.title: Ritual of Binding
cube_warper.quest.76E7F42F53A92906.descr: Warp Flux can be used to warp some materials into others.
cube_warper.quest.773644DBBADB3907.descr: You can use Error Cubes to make Antimater in the Reaction Chamber.
Crystalising Antimater will result in Atomic Alloy.
cube_warper.quest.7901F7F30F475BE1.descr: The Stationary Charging Station uses Extraterrestial Crystal technology to charge advanced tools for free over time.
cube_warper.quest.79CA283CB3EAD8A8.descr: You will need to difuse a nuclear bomb to obtain the Fission Core within.
First use a Crowbar to pry the top off of the bomb.
Then use Wire Cutters to cut one of the wires.
Left-clicking will cut the red wire.
Right-clicking will cut the green wire.
One wire will difuse the bomb; the other will rig the device to explode within 10 seconds.
The correct wire, unfortunately, is always fully random...
cube_warper.quest.79CA283CB3EAD8A8.title: Defusing a Nuclear Bomb
cube_warper.quest.7A7024EDC415AAB8.descr: You can extract endless sap from a tree by placing an Extruder on a log and placing lava and a block of Alchemical Calx next to the machine.
cube_warper.quest.7A7024EDC415AAB8.title: Infinite Sap Extraction
cube_warper.quest.7A7CCA02D1D6DE9D.descr: Mechanical Crafting is needed in order to make the Crushing Wheels.
cube_warper.quest.7A7CCA02D1D6DE9D.title: Mechanical Crafting
cube_warper.quest.7AFCECBEEE6C2FBB.descr: You can import and export any item or fluid using an import or export bus.
cube_warper.quest.7B40E840FEA205E1.descr: You can add the two parts of a Machine Frame together by placing the bottom half into the world and then right-clicking the top half onto it.
cube_warper.quest.7B40E840FEA205E1.title: Machine Frame
cube_warper.quest.7D0109AE975E49BE.title: Renewable Diamonds
cube_warper.quest.7F2977D3C91BEA05.descr: You can now make Light Engineering Blocks. This will allow you to setup an industrial fermenter.
cube_warper.quest.7F8A84E6792D57C5.title: Welcome to dimension 18: &lThe Silver Forest
cube_warper.quest.7FD33D4C061B4802.descr: You can now store your items on a Storage Cell.
The biggest part of AE2 is quite cheap so that you have the tools to automate things early.
cube_warper.quest.7FD33D4C061B4802.title: Digital Storage
cube_warper.quest.7FE20D4DE2E912CB.descr: A steam engine placed above an active nuclear furnace will be automatically heated to &lthe maximum heat level&r.
You can keep cycling goop through the furnace to keep it active. This will practically create the equivalent of a nuclear reactor.
cube_warper.quest.7FE20D4DE2E912CB.title: The Goop Cycle
cube_warper.task.309419B5A56E0419: Enter to dimension 9: &lThe Horizon of Cinders
cube_warper.task.61ABF0B11CAED1DA: I will Break all the Things!
